correctness.rationale: All fourteen classes and their class-to-class incidence counts follow from projective-plane axioms, then refinement is stable after two rounds. Three-point collinear markings admit a moving elation. Four frame points in prime-field planes generate every point and line by uniquely defined joins/meets; an explicit additive affine construction proves the generation for all primes. Direct exact programs verified the auxiliary steps for p=2,3,5,7,11,13; finite tests do not replace proof.

evidence: Chen, Ren and Ponomarenko, arXiv:2311.09940, Theorem 1.4 and Sec. 8.3 prove equivalence of unmarked order-matched plane incidence graphs under higher-dimensional WL and calculate a one-point coherent extension in Sec. 8.4. They do not explicitly supply the present 14-class two-round profile for three independently marked points or point-landmark minimum 3/4.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Higher-dimensional unmarked indistinguishability is strong relevant coverage of the unmarked subclaim. It does not itself give the sharp minimum marked point count or the exact 14-cell partition. Those statements require the additional geometric counting and frame-closure proof.

value.rationale: A complete natural point-individualization invariant on an infinite family of finite projective planes, and an all-plane 14-cell rigidity barrier, connect projective geometry and logical expressive power. For prime p>=23 the landmark number four is sharply smaller than the known metric resolving number 4p-4 because WL propagates algebraic incidence constructions.
